user.title: Sentrymo
user.description: Connect your Sentrymo vehicles to Home Assistant.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Sentrymo
reauth_confirm.description: Enter a new pairing key. Enter the 4-digit CPIN if command controls should remain available.

error.setup_key_expired: The pairing key has expired or has already been used
error.feature_unavailable: The Home Assistant feature is not available in the current Sentrymo package
error.permission_denied: The integration does not have permission for this operation

init.title: Sentrymo options
init.description: Choose which Sentrymo environment this integration should use.

command_missing_cpin.message: This command requires a 4-digit CPIN stored in the Sentrymo integration. Re-pair the integration to add it.

command_invalid_cpin.message: Sentrymo rejected the stored CPIN. Re-pair the integration with the current CPIN.

command_cpin_locked.message: CPIN verification is temporarily locked. Wait before trying the command again.

command_output_not_configured.message: This output is not configured for the selected vehicle.

command_vehicle_unavailable.message: The selected vehicle is no longer available to this integration.

command_permission_denied.message: This integration does not have permission or command scope for that operation.

command_commands_disabled.message: Commands are disabled for this Sentrymo integration.

command_unsupported.message: This command is not supported for the selected vehicle.

command_rate_limited.message: Sentrymo is rate-limiting commands. Wait before trying again.

command_authentication_required.message: Sentrymo authentication is no longer valid. Complete reauthentication before trying again.

command_entitlement_unavailable.message: The Home Assistant feature is not available in the current Sentrymo package.

command_temporarily_unavailable.message: Sentrymo is temporarily unavailable. The command was not acknowledged; try again later.

command_failed.message: Sentrymo did not accept the command.

command_vehicle_ambiguous.message: This vehicle exists in more than one Sentrymo config entry. Specify entry_id.

entitlement_unavailable.title: Sentrymo feature unavailable
entitlement_unavailable.description: The Home Assistant feature is not available in the current Sentrymo package. The config entry is retained and its existing entities remain unavailable until server access is restored.
